from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split the image at its central one-cell divider.
    if w % 2 == 1 and all(row[w // 2] == grid[0][w // 2] for row in grid):
        mid = w // 2
        left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
        right = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    elif h % 2 == 1 and all(v == grid[h // 2][0] for v in grid[h // 2]):
        mid = h // 2
        left = grid[:mid]
        right = grid[mid + 1:]
    else:
        raise ValueError("no central divider found")
    background = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(left))]
